title: Hall of Famer Brian Dawkins said he did not give Homeland Security permission to use his highlights in social media video

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Hall of Famer Brian Dawkins said he did not give Homeland Security permission to use his highlights in social media video
sources.description: The NFL asked the DHS to remove the video, which was posted on Sunday in reference to a purported migrant caravan.
